name: Atlantic hurricanes
summary: No Atlantic tropical cyclone active or threatening land on 28 Nov; the 2026 season ends on 30 Nov
state: GDACS listed no active tropical cyclone anywhere at 00:31 UTC on 28 Nov (GDACS), and searches found no Atlantic storm or disturbance with formation potential. The National Hurricane Center issues Atlantic outlooks until the season formally ends on 30 Nov (NOAA NHC). With nothing threatening land within five days, Normal holds.
for_you: No Atlantic storm threatens land. Travellers to the Caribbean and US Gulf coast face normal conditions; follow National Hurricane Center updates.
